description: This file is a Python script for migrating a Tiny ERP server database, including database cleanup operations and configuration parsing.

methods.name: parser.add_option
methods.description: Adds command-line options for database configuration and script parameters.

methods.name: parser.add_option_group
methods.description: Creates a group of related command-line options for database parameters.

methods.name: parser.parse_args
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments and populates options object.

methods.name: configparser.read
methods.description: Reads configuration from specified config file.

methods.name: configparser.items
methods.description: Retrieves key-value pairs from a specific section in the config file.

methods.name: psycopg.connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the PostgreSQL database.

methods.name: cr.execute
methods.description: Executes SQL commands to delete menu entries and ir_values.

methods.name: cr.commit
methods.description: Commits the current transaction to the database.
